description: HVDC-Wise lib publishes high-voltage direct-current equipment model specifications for exchange between power-system simulation tools. Its project team separates static topology and equipment parameters from dynamic equations and solver artifacts, using extensions to IEC CIM and CGMES exchange profiles. Users select an equipment model and translate the provided artifacts into their chosen simulator; the outputs are exchangeable model descriptions, not a completed network run. Geographic and temporal coverage depend on the system and dynamic study to which the models are applied. The repository has public documentation, examples and EUPL-1.2 terms. A limitation is that the library does not itself validate an imported model or supply a universal executable for every target solver. This is useful when assembling interoperable HVDC transmission simulations. The catalogue's model-dpsim can read CIM and CGMES models, but compatibility with these specific library artifacts was not tested. No equipment artifact was downloaded.
name: HVDC-Wise model-exchange library
